title: Jesus Stopped Reading Mid-Sentence
thread: In the synagogue of His home town Nazareth, Jesus read from the prophet Isaiah, stopped, closed the book and sat down (Luke 4:16-20); Luke 4:19 ends at the acceptable year of the Lord, and the sentence in Isaiah 61:2 goes on: and the day of vengeance of our God; the Bible does not say why Jesus stopped there; He said This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears (Luke 4:21); the people wanted miracles, Physician, heal thyself (Luke 4:23); Jesus reminded them God once sent help to a foreign widow and to Naaman the Syrian (Luke 4:25-27); the crowd, filled with wrath, led Him to the brow of the hill to cast Him down headlong, but He passing through the midst of them went his way (Luke 4:28-30); later at the cross the rulers said He saved others; let him save himself (Luke 23:35); this time He stayed, Christ died for our sins and rose again the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3-4)
